subject: dsa
title: Walls and Gates
summary: Run one BFS from every gate at the same time. Each wave reaches the rooms one step farther away, filling each room with its distance to the nearest gate.
problem: Fill each empty room with its distance to the nearest gate. 0 is a gate, -1 is a wall, and the symbol for infinity marks an empty room. Use a multi-source BFS that starts from all gates at once.

steps.caption: Fill each empty room with its distance to the nearest gate. The gates are the two 0 cells.
Distance 1. The rooms next to a gate get 1.
Distance 2. The next wave reaches rooms one step farther out.
Distance 3. Two more rooms are filled.
Distance 4. The last room fills with 4.
Done. Every room now holds its distance to the nearest gate.
